# markov

## Introduction

### Key Features

## Installation

You can install the release version of `markov` from CRAN by running the
following line of code:

``` r

 install.packages("markov")
```

You can install the development version of `markov` from github by
running the following line of code:

``` r

 devtools::install_github("thechibo/markov")
```

More details can be found in the [markov Github
repository](https://github.com/thechibo/markov "markov Github repository").

## Documentation

Detailed documentation, along with reproducible examples, can be found
in the package vignette
[`vignette(topic = "markov", package = "markov")`](articles/markov.md).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`avail()`](avail.md) : Availability of a Markov chain
- [`estim_parallel()`](estim_parallel.md) : Parallel Estimation
- [`is_irreducible()`](is_irreducible.md) : Test Whether a Markov Chain
  Is Irreducible
- [`mat_gamma()`](mat_gamma.md) : Asymptotic Variance–Covariance of the
  Transition Probability Vector
- [`mat_sigma()`](mat_sigma.md) : Sigma Matrix
- [`mat_sigma_sl()`](mat_sigma_sl.md) : Title
- [`mc_estim()`](mc_estim.md) : Estimate a Markov chain from an observed
  state sequence
- [`mc_sim()`](mc_sim.md) : Simulate a Markov Chain Trajectory
- [`mc_stat()`](mc_stat.md) : Stationary Distribution of a Markov Chain
- [`mttf()`](mttf.md) [`var_mttf()`](mttf.md) [`var_mttf_sl()`](mttf.md)
  [`deriv_psi()`](mttf.md) : Mean Time to Failure
- [`nstates()`](nstates.md) : Number of States
- [`var_avail()`](var_avail.md) : Variance of availability
- [`var_stat()`](var_stat.md) : Asymptotic Variance–Covariance Matrix of
  the stationary distribution MLE
